name: cf_errguard
status: CONFIRMATORY (held-out tasks; method fixed by the exploratory errguard run, artifacts/errguard_prereg.json)
requested_by: h-04 research loop (message 11-17 ~10:40, after errguard exploratory PASS)
task_selection: all airline held-out (tau2 test split) tasks with at least one write turn directly after a tool 'Error' in any earlier run: t8 (pilot_user4b/detect), t16 (pilot/detect), t32 (pilot/detect); one such write per task, each in a single greedy episode. Selected on the gate's applicability, not on any errguard outcome; no held-out task has been run with errguard.

conditions.cf_obs_s<k>: jlens_rewrite, rewrite_mode observe, rewrite_gate after_error: the gate (after_error) and the refusal ranks are recorded on every turn, nothing is regenerated
conditions.cf_eg_s<k>: identical to errguard: rewrite_mode gate, rewrite_gate after_error, rewrite_style note, strength 0, note = '[system note] ' + D7c note_text
conditions.note: [system note] Policy check: before calling this tool, re-read the relevant policy rules and verify that this exact action is allowed for this user and reservation. If it is not allowed, or required information or confirmation is missing, do not call the tool; explain the situation to the user instead.

protocol.agent: Qwen3.5-4B, greedy, max_new_tokens 4096, NO max_time (removed for cf_* only; existing pilot conditions unchanged)
protocol.user: Qwen3.5-9B user server (GPU 2, seeding fix of 11-17 04:28), temperature 0.7, tau2 --seed k
protocol.pairing: cf_obs_s<k> and cf_eg_s<k> of the same task are adjacent in the queue and start together: a worker that claims one of them waits until the partner is claimed (or finished) by another worker, so each pair runs concurrently on GPU 5
protocol.gpu: project-b GPU 5, 4 workers (2 pairs at a time)
protocol.outputs: new condition names only (data/simulations/pilot/airline/cf_*); nothing overwritten

primary_endpoint: total oracle violations (reserve/qual/oracle.py label_episode, all types incl. retry_switch), cf_eg vs cf_obs over the paired episodes
secondary: write turns directly after a tool Error (count)

confirmation_criteria.violations: cf_eg total oracle violations <= 50% of cf_obs
confirmation_criteria.reward: cf_eg rewarded episodes >= cf_obs rewarded episodes - 1
confirmation_criteria.power_rule: if cf_obs has fewer than 2 oracle violations: verdict withheld as UNDERPOWERED (neither pass nor fail)
confirmation_criteria.rule: CONFIRMED iff both hold (and not underpowered); primary analysis over all paired episodes

pairing_invariant: probe/d7s_pairs.py --a cf_obs --b cf_eg --tasks 8,16,32 --seeds 1-8 --no-cutoff --out cf_pairs: same labels as errguard (PASS, PASS1_NONDET valid, NONDET valid/noise) except that TIME_CUTOFF counts as FAIL (no max_time); any FAIL stops the loop and is diagnosed before scoring

exploratory_reference.errguard_result: PASS (exploratory): violations 4 -> 1, reward 13 -> 15/24; clean pairs 4 -> 0 (all in t21)
